name: list_startup_programs
description: List all programs set to run at Windows startup
task_prompt:
Write a Python script that lists ALL Windows startup programs from:
  1. HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run
  2. HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run
  3. HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run
  4. %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup (folder)
  5. C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp (folder)
Use winreg for registry keys. For each entry print: source, name, command/path.
